items.rootCause: OWNER-REGISTRY SIBLING-PRUNE RACE in scene3d/particles/owner_registry.js (`?particleOwner`, DEFAULT-ON) — NOT the emitter decode, playback, blending, quality clamp, or the CallPES loop. `ParticleOwnerRegistry.addEmitter` takes the owner record BEFORE its `await`, and a create that FAILS calls `_pruneOwner`, which deletes the record when it finds it empty. Two CreateParticle hooks from ONE script in ONE tick therefore race: the slow create (real GfxObj -> fetchBuildingPlacement + material) enters first and awaits; the fast one fails instantly on retail's `hwGfxObjId === 0` destroy sentinel and prunes the SHARED record; the slow create then resolves, its `liveRec !== rec` test reads the pruned map, concludes the owner despawned, and DESTROYS a perfectly good emitter. PhysicsScript 0x3300067A (Setup 0x020001B3 default_script) is exactly that shape: CreateParticle 0x320002CD @t=0 (hw GfxObj 0x010016C8 = THE SWIRL; type 9 ParabolicLVLALR, 12 particles, birthrate 1/6 s, lifespan 2 s, scale 5.0->0.1, trans 1.0->0.4, surface 0x08000498 = Base1Image|Alpha|Additive, luminosity 1) and CreateParticle 0x320002D6 @t=0 (hw GfxObj 0 -> inert; it carries only a SOFTWARE gfxObjId 0x010016C9, and retail/ACE bail on hw==0 too — ParticleEmitter::SetInfo acclient.c:330930-330934, ACE ParticleEmitter.cs:106-110). So every town portal rolled a die on whether its own swirl survived its sibling's failure => the bare pedestal. 41 of the 4,248 PhysicsScripts in client_portal.dat have this >=2-CreateParticle-with-a-mix shape (all the portal family 0x3300067A / 0x330006FA-FE plus 35 others), so this was not portal-only.
items.chainVerified: 0x3300067A = 4 hooks: CreateParticle 0x320002CD, CreateParticle 0x320002D6, SoundTweaked 0x0A00038E (prob 1.0, vol 0.05), CallPES 0x330006DA @t=2.7 pause=0.0. CallPES target 0x330006DA is a SOUND-ONLY self-loop (SoundTweaked + CallPES back into itself at 2.7 s) — it carries NO CreateParticle, so the swirl is NOT sustained by the loop: the emitters are created once at t=0 and run forever (total_particles=0, total_seconds=0 => persistent). Colored variants 0x330006FA/FB/FC/FD/FE are identical in shape (emitters 0x320003B2/B4/B5/B7/B9/BA). Parsed straight from client_portal.dat (btree walk + ACE ParticleEmitterInfo/AnimationHook field order); WBT's chorizite-parse-dat-record elides hook payloads.
items.fix: scene3d/particles/owner_registry.js — per-owner IN-FLIGHT CREATE COUNTER (`rec.pending`): incremented before the await, decremented on every resolve path, and `_pruneOwner` refuses to drop a record while it is non-zero. Real despawns are unaffected: `destroyAllForOwner` bumps the epoch unconditionally, and the EPOCH term of `ownerGone` still tombstones in-flight creates. New URL flag `?particleOwnerPending` (DEFAULT ON, `=off` restores the legacy prune) — same escape-hatch shape as `?callPesLoop`. Docs row added to docs/url-flags.md (Particles/VFX table + the reader index); lint-url-flags + audit-flag-defaults clean. Headless regression: test_particle_owner.mjs grew 6 `sibling-race:` checks (42 -> 48 passing), including 'despawn still tombstones an in-flight create'. DEFAULT (ON) -> 3 emitters, the near one num=10-11 live / 10 visible, totalEmitted 306-547 => FULL PURPLE SWIRL. notes: NOT the cause (each checked + ruled out): emitter decode (our ParticleEmitter struct matches ACE.DatLoader/ParticleEmitterInfo.cs field-for-field and the PDB offsets at typeid 15a69); the maxParticlesPerEmitter quality clamp (12 requested vs 64 on the LOW preset — never trips); additive blending (surface 0x08000498 is Base1Image|Alpha|Additive and materials.js already routes the 0x10000 bit to AdditiveBlending via getParticleUnlit); the CallPES self-loop (already fixed by ?callPesLoop 2026-08-04 and confirmed running); the 062e5ce3 albedoFullyTransparent veto (it only gates the BC7 upgrade, never particle quads).

start_trans 1.0 -> final_trans 0.4 IS retail: translucency, 1 = invisible (CMaterial::SetTranslucencySimple sets alpha = 1 - trans, acclient.c:360594; SetTranslucency(1.0) also sets the NODRAW draw_state bit, acclient.c:315499). So a portal particle spawns huge + invisible and converges as it shrinks and fades IN. Our setTranslucency in scene3d/particles/particle.js already matches.
0x320002D6 never draws in RETAIL either (hw GfxObj 0). Rendering its software gfxObjId 0x010016C9 would be a DEVIATION, not a fix — left alone deliberately.

The Yaraq town portal is a SERVER ENTITY (guid 0x77D6406A, wcid 43066, physicsScriptDid 0 -> Track B `fetchSetupDefaultScript(0x020001B3)` -> 0x3300067A), so the entity walker in entities.js is the path under test, NOT statics.js's V1 walker. The dais + obelisks around it are the baked static.

Side observation, NOT fixed here: a portal's per-guid ScriptManager was seen at scriptsCompleted ~7,000 in a ~400 s session (~17 Hz), far above the 1 iteration / 2.7 s the 0x330006DA loop should run at. Worth a look as its own item — it is a CPU/scheduling question, not a visual one, and the swirl is correct with it.
